project.name: POS Maroc
project.description: Point of Sale system for Moroccan restaurants/cafés with role-based access (Admin, Waiter, Kitchen), NativeWind UI, Supabase backend, and offline sync

tasks.title: Project Setup & Configuration
tasks.description: Initialize Expo project with NativeWind, configure Tailwind, Metro bundler, TypeScript, and babel. Setup ThemeProvider and ThemeToggle components.

tasks.title: Create Root Layout
tasks.description: Setup app/_layout.tsx with ThemeProvider, Stack navigation, and global CSS imports.

tasks.title: Create Login Screen with PIN Authentication
tasks.description: PIN-based login (4 digits) with role detection: 1111=Admin, 2222=Waiter, 3333=Kitchen. Store session in AsyncStorage and redirect based on role.

tasks.title: Create Role-Based Screens Skeleton
tasks.description: Create waiter-tables.tsx, waiter-order.tsx, kitchen-orders.tsx, admin-dashboard.tsx with basic structure. Each screen accessible based on user role.

tasks.title: Create Admin Products Management
tasks.description: List, add, edit products. Fields: name, price (MAD), category. Simple form with flat design.

tasks.title: Create Admin Categories Management
tasks.description: List, add, edit categories. Simple list with add/edit functionality.

tasks.title: Create Admin Tables Management
tasks.description: List, add, edit tables. Shows table numbers and allows basic management.

tasks.title: Create Admin Daily Reports Screen
tasks.description: View today's orders and simple daily total in MAD. No complex accounting, just basic order list and sum.

tasks.title: Setup Supabase Integration
tasks.description: Create Supabase client, authentication helpers, and database service functions. Include offline queue system with SQLite.

tasks.title: Setup Zustand Store
tasks.description: Create global state management for user session, orders, products, and offline sync queue.

tasks.title: Create Database Schema & Seed Data
tasks.description: SQL file with tables (users, tables, categories, products, orders, order_items), RLS policies, and seed data with Moroccan products.

tasks.title: Implement Offline Sync System
tasks.description: SQLite local database for offline orders. Sync queue that automatically syncs when connection returns. Prevent duplicates using UUIDs.

tasks.title: Create Waiter Tables Selection Screen
tasks.description: Grid of tables showing status (free/occupied/has-order). Tap table to select and go to order screen. Show table number and current order total if exists.

tasks.title: Create Waiter Order Screen
tasks.description: Product list by category, add to current order, show running total in MAD. Buttons: Send to Kitchen, Print Bill. Update order status.

tasks.title: Create Kitchen Orders Screen
tasks.description: List of pending orders with items. Mark items/orders as ready. Audio notification for new orders. Show table number prominently.

tasks.title: Implement Real-time Updates
tasks.description: Supabase realtime subscriptions for orders. Kitchen gets new orders instantly. Waiter sees when order is ready.

tasks.title: Add Receipt/Bill Printing
tasks.description: Generate printable receipt with items, prices in MAD, total, date/time. Support thermal printer or PDF export.

tasks.title: Add User Management (Admin)
tasks.description: Admin can add/edit staff. Set name, PIN, role (waiter/kitchen). Simple list with CRUD operations.

tasks.title: Create UI Components Library
tasks.description: Reusable components: Button, Card, Input, Badge, Modal, BottomSheet. Following NativeWind/Tailwind patterns from theme.md.

tasks.title: Add Logout & Session Management
tasks.description: Logout button on all screens. Clear AsyncStorage on logout. Auto-logout after inactivity (optional). Redirect to login if no session.
